The blue component at the top center (likely a water fill cap) blends slightly into the white body without a clear mechanical seam or hinge definition, appearing somewhat 'melted' into the casing.
The pink handle on the right seems to attach to the body with a slightly ambiguous connection point, lacking a clear structural joint.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of appliance and rule out misclassification as similar objects like shoe stretchers or specialized cleaners.
To verify the boundary between the soleplate and the plastic body, ensuring no fusion artifacts exist along the seam.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'steam holes'—in AI images, these often fail to look like actual holes (lacking interior shadow/depth). Also, check the blue water cap for logical mechanical attachment; AI often struggles with small protruding functional parts.
